title: Worst Candy I Have EVER Tasted!
text: This was gifted to me. When it showed up at my house I was excited because I love candy and it looked cool. Once I opened the box, I noticed that a bunch of the candy had melted together. Disappointing, but not a game changer. However, once I opened the containers to try the gummies, I couldn't even get them out of the container because they had hardened into one massive gummie lump. Once I finally cut a piece out, it was terrible, then I tried a little of each one, and for the first time in my sweets-loving life, I wasn't willing to try a second bite of any of it. I eat a lot of candy and I'm not very picky, but this candy tasted like chemicals and had a mouth feel like plastic. I even called my sister to tell her to never gift this to anyone ever again because it was so bad! She was very sad and disappointed because she said it looked so good and she knew how much I liked candy. If I could give it 0 stars, I would. I don't care how cute the package is, if your product tastes like crap, awesome packaging can't make up for it and those who gave it 1 or 2 stars for cute packaging were being waaaaaay too nice.
label: negative
